description: 500 synthetic rental-screening records. 12 lack source_document_hash (chain-of-custody breaks). 47 share an input_hash with another record but produce a divergent score under the same model_version (vendor score drift).
_synthetic_note: Full 500-record dataset would be deterministically generated; this README excerpt shows the schema. The replay.py module synthesizes the full dataset programmatically in synthetic_dataset() for repeatability without committing 500 JSON records to the repo.
